insights: Home Improvement Contractor Registration: Connecticut requires HIC registration for contractors Connecticut Department of Consumer Protection requires Home Improvement Contractor registration—verify at portal.ct.gov/dcp. Registration protects consumers through the Home Improvement Guaranty Fund.

Very High Construction Costs: Connecticut has some of the highest construction costs in the US Labor costs are 30-50% above national average. Reddit warns that very low bids usually mean unlicensed workers or shortcuts.

Ice Dams & Winter Damage: Connecticut winters cause significant ice dam and freeze damage Ice dams cause major interior damage. Reddit strongly recommends proper attic insulation and ventilation, plus ice/water shield extending past eaves.

Lead Paint in Older Homes: Connecticut has extensive pre-1978 housing with lead paint Connecticut has strict lead paint requirements. EPA RRP rules apply, and the state has additional requirements for certain properties.
